English Proficiency Requirements
International applicants who do not meet the requirements for a waiver are required to submit English proficiency scores.
test
minimum requirements
how to send
TOEFL iBT / TOEFL iBT Home Edition
(taken before Jan. 2026)
Total score 81
Send via ETS using institution code 6681 and department code 01
TOEFL iBT / TOEFL iBT Home Edition
(taken after Jan. 2026)
Total score 4.5
Send via ETS using institution code 6681 and department code 01
IELTS
Overall score of 7 with no subscore less than 6
Send through your IELTS Testing Center
DuoLingo (DET)
Score of 120 or above
Send via DuoLingo English Test
PTE
Overall score of 68 with no subscore less than 58
Email [email protected] with your Score Report Code
The on-campus English Placement Evaluation (EPE) will be required unless you submit a TOEFL overall score of 100 (taken before Jan. 2026) 5.0 (taken after Jan. 2026) or higher, or an IELTS overall score of 8.0 or higher.
All students admitted using DuoLingo (DET) or PTE test scores will be required to take the EPE when they arrive on campus.
We do not accept the TOEFL MyBest Superscore or the IELTS One Skill Retake.
English proficiency requirements vary by program. Please check if there are specific requirements for your program.
Waiver Eligibility
Applicants will be given a waiver if they are a citizen, or have earned the equivalent of a bachelor’s degree, master's degree, or Ph.D. in the United States, or any of the following countries:
Antigua and Barbuda
Australia
Bahamas
Barbados
Belize
Bermuda
Botswana
Cameroon (English speaking side)
Canada
Dominica
Gambia
Ghana
Grenada
Guyana
Ireland
Jamaica
Kenya
Lesotho
Liberia
Malawi
Namibia
New Zealand
Nigeria
Sierra Leone
South Africa
St. Christopher & Nevis
St. Lucia
St. Vincent & the Grenadines
Tanzania
Trinidad & Tobago
Uganda
United Kingdom
Zambia
Zimbabwe
A degree from a host university in this list is not eligible for a waiver if it is completed outside of that country, e.g. a degree from a US institution completed at a campus located in China.
English medium institutions are not sufficient for a waiver if they are completed in a country not on this list.
